knownDefects.note: Capabilities an engine advertises but does not deliver, at the recorded component and Realm versions. The plugin must not claim them, and must not paper over them: the owning case fails rather than reporting N/A. Freshness has two independent dimensions (ADR 0026): `componentVersion` is checked against whichever of the wrapper and `engines` baselines names this entry's own `component`, and `realmVersion` against this file's top-level `realmVersion` — a move in either forces the entry to be re-examined, and the gate names which one. A baseline the entry does not name is irrelevant to it. `realmVersion` is required: an undated entry is a shape problem, never an entry judged fresh. One hole survives and is deliberate: an entry whose component appears in neither baseline never expires on the component dimension, so it rests on the Realm dimension alone; closing it belongs to ADR 0012 §2.

entries.summary: The wrapper advertises capabilities.session.fork and then answers session/fork with Resource not found.
entries.impact: session_fork returns ENGINE_ERROR on claude-code. There is no plugin-side workaround: the capability is read from the engine descriptor, so the plugin reports what the engine claims and fails the call the engine fails.
entries.evidence: release/gates/engine-2026-09-01T06-04-14-512Z.md (live supplementary run, plugin 0.1.0-alpha.4 @ 96ed6bfd986d, artifact 515a4a47c2711d07, Claude Code 2.1.252 newer than declared host baseline 2.1.238 via claude-agent-acp 0.70.0, runskein 0.1.1, darwin arm64); ENG-FORK-001-claude-code fails with Resource not found while round trip and capability pass; the new wrapper therefore retains this known defect at the upgraded versions

entries.summary: The descriptor advertises capabilities.session.fork; session/fork then fails with `pi exited (code 1): No session found matching '<id>'` — the shim asks pi to fork a session pi does not know.
entries.impact: session_fork returns ENGINE_ERROR on pi. Everything else in the ENG matrix passes: create, two turns, transcript and close all work.
